مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1, which 
must be performed every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the title block.

There are two unwatering pumps one in the North 
main sump tank and the other in the South main sump tank and their type CT3230 ( 
used for unwatering the turbine water path in maintenance )
Technical Specifications:
Rated power : 132 kw

Rated speed 
: 1480 rpm

Rated flow : 200 
L/sec
Delivery head : 45 m. wc

The first draft was initiated by eng. Abd Elnabi 
Ibrahim , revised and tested by eng. Al sayed Ibrahim Al-Ashmony, accepted by general 
director eng. Abd elghaffar Osman, approved by eng. Ahmed Mohamed Yonis; 
Head Sector of Aswan ( 1 & 2 ) Power Station and certified by eng. Mohamed 
Osama Soliman HPGC inspection and quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة
يجب إصدار تصريح العمل.
Tيجب أن يحمل موظفو الصيانة فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

مضخة 
should be out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically and electrically.

The motor should be disconnected from MCC,
 control panel 
by electric maintenance 
 section and hang caution marks.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Make sure that the lifting equipment is in good condition
Get out the pump from the sump

Check the condition of carrying handle , lifting eyes , 
 chains and wire cables
Check that the guide bars are vertical

Rinse the pump thoroughly with clean water before starting 
 work , good clean of the outer pump surface
Clean the pass of cooling pump system
Check the pump casing and impeller

Check the clearance between the impeller skirt and the 
 pump casin
( not exeeds 2 mm. ) if it exeeds 2 mm. replacing the wear ring ( 
 13 )

Check the condition of oil through the oil hole screw ( 1 
 )

Take some of oil from the bottom of oil casing and sure 
 that no water mixed with oil , then check that the oil reaches up to oil 
 hole

If there is water mixed with oil . the oil then became 
 cream-like and oil must be change ( about 14 liters )

Replace a new O ring (2), good tightness for the oil plug 
 (1). Mark : if the oil full change because there is water in the casing 
 oil , the pump must be inspect again after one operation week
Check the liquid ( water / oil ) in the stator casing :

Warning : resulting from leakage , there my be over 
 pressure in
غلاف الجزء الثابت. أمسك قطعة قماش فوق برغي الفحص
Prevent splatter .

Tilt the pump so that any liquid in the stator casing can 
 run out
Through the hole

If there is water in the stator casing the cause may be : 
 * That the inspection cover (4) is no tight enough 
 * That O ring (5) is damaged 
 * That cable entries (11) are leaking 
 .
If there oil in the stator casing the cause may be :

That the inner mechanical seal (7) 
 is damaged and must be replaced

أن الحلقة يا (9) تالفة و 
 يجب استبداله

Check the cable entry : make sure 
 that the cable clamps are tight
Check the pipes , valves

Lay down the pump in it is seat 
 and sure that it is in proper position

Check the function of operation of 
 the pump .
